profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and deploying web applications, data visualization platforms, and search tools for cancer and genomic research. Proven success modernizing legacy systems, implementing scalable cloud solutions, and enabling scientists to analyze large-scale biomedical data. Skilled in full-stack development, cloud platforms, and UI/UX design. Published author in peer-reviewed journals.

positions.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developing the BioData Catalyst web application for the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI): Delivering innovative solutions to enhance platform functionality, expand
accessibility and content capabilities, and reduce technical debt across existing
software systems. Facilitate high-leverage decisions about architecture and software
development.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · React.js · Azure DevOps Services · Material-UI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I have developed and maintained web applications under the ISB-CGC project, funded by NCI, providing cancer data analysis and search tools built on the Google Cloud platform. I also transferred and modernized three of the old NCI's legacy cancer data applications into intuitive, faster, cloud-based applications. The developed applications include the Mitelman Database, BigQuery Table Search, the TP53 Database, and the Chernobyl Tissue Bank.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Django · Flask · D3.js · PL/SQL · Pycharm · CircleCI · Git · DataTables · Bootstrap

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked with data scientists at the Kolker lab to develop and maintain two web applications used by proteomics researchers to aid data query, analysis, and visualization.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · D3.js · Spring MVC · Hibernate · PL/SQL · Jenkins · Gradle · AspectJ

positions.title: J2EE Application Developer
positions.description: I worked on developing web applications for research admins to manage clients' oncology data and treatment and generate reports.

positions.title: J2EE Application Developer
positions.description: Serviced to the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, I supported administrative web applications used in over 90 VA medical centers nationwide, including the VA Central Office located in Washington, DC.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · PL/SQL · JavaScript · Spring MVC · Hibernate · Eclipse · JSP · JSTL · Jboss

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: I developed mobile games and applications on the Java platform, enabling users to download, edit, and individualize multimedia content on mobile services. Ported applications were published to a wide range of handsets for major US carriers.

positions.title: Mobile Application Porting Developer
positions.description:
I ported numerous mobile apps and games to 80+ handsets for AT&T, T-Mobile, Sprint, and Verizon.
-	Used skills & Tools:  J2ME, Brew(C++), Eclipse, CVS.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · C++ · J2ME · BREW · Eclipse · CVS

publications.title: The ISB Cancer Gateway in the Cloud (ISB-CGC): Access, explore and analyze large-scale cancer data through the Google Cloud
